name: Tortilla Chips
ingredients_raw: Corn (69%), Refined Edible Palmolein Oil (TBHQ), Iodized Salt, Maltodextrin, Spices & Condiments (Chilli Powder (0.7%), Coriander Powder (0.5%), Cumin Powder (0.1%), Nutmeg Powder, Clove Powder, Cardamom Powder), Sugar, Dehydrated Vegetables (Onion Powder (0.6%), Tomato Powder (0.4%), Garlic Powder (0.2%)), Milk Solids (Whey Powder), Acidity Regulator (Citric Acid), Stabilizer (Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein), Natural Flavour (Chilli), Nature Identical Flavour (Jalapeno), Flavour Enhancers (Disodium Guanylate, Disodium Inosinate) & Parsley Flakes. Contains Milk and its products.
